newsitem.title: USA: Arthuis - G7 had converging views on dollar.
newsitem.headline: Arthuis - G7 had converging views on dollar.

text.p: French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis said on Monday that Group of Seven rich nations had "converging analyses" on exchange rate trends and current rates broadly reflected economic fundamentals.

"I am pleased that the G7 countries had converging analyses of exchange rate trends in the world at the meeting yesterday," he said in a statement to the International Monetary Fund's policy-making Interim Committee.

"This confirms that international cooperation on these issues is of an excellent quality and that the orderly reversal of parities initiated in the spring of 1995 and reaffirmed at the Lyon (G7) summit, continues to bear fruit," he said, according to a text of his statement.

"The current parities on foreign exchange markets broadly reflect economic fundamentals. This is a major achievement, which should not be undermined by the re-emergence of excessive external imbalances," he said.
